// The re-wired Penrose Wall: six simultaneous LED strings of 300 LEDs each,
// bottom-to-top orientation. Output j owns global LED indexes
// [j*300, j*300+300). Converted from the hardware-side newdata.txt mapping.
//
// Format: outputs = the physical LED strings, in output order. Each 'leds'
// array lists, in daisy-chain order along that string, the HALF-TILE index
// (0..1799) that LED displays. Tile index = value / 2 (two LEDs per tile,
// one per triangle). All outputs together must cover 0..1799 exactly once.
//
// Global LED index = (output number x LEDs in earlier outputs) + position in
// string; the S2 Mini boards claim [start,count) slices of that global index
// space in their handshake (see Assets/core/Hardware/S2_MINI_PROTOCOL.md).
//
// Loaded by WiringData.ParseToWireMap (Assets/core/Runtime/WallData.cs), which
// flattens outputs into one wire map and validates the 0..1799 permutation.
// Comment lines (starting with '//') are stripped before JSON parsing.
// =============================================================================
